en: Krishna said: Because you do not find fault, I will tell you this deepest secret, knowledge together with its practical understanding. Knowing it, you will be freed from evil.
This is the king of sciences, the king of secrets, the purest and highest. It is known by direct experience, it is in line with dharma, it is easy to practise, and it does not perish.
Destroyer of foes, people who have no faith in this teaching do not reach me. They return to the path of death and rebirth.
This whole world is filled by me in my unseen form. All beings rest in me, but I do not rest in them.

first: न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम् ।
en: And yet beings do not rest in me. See my divine power! My self supports beings and brings them into being, but does not rest in them.
Just as the great wind, moving everywhere, always rests in space, know that all beings rest in me in the same way.
Son of Kunti, at the end of an age all beings go back into my nature. At the start of the next age I send them forth again.
Taking hold of my own nature, I send forth again and again this whole crowd of beings, which is helpless under the power of nature.

first: न च मां तानि कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनंजय ।
en: Dhananjaya, these actions do not bind me, for I sit as if unconcerned, unattached to those actions.
Under my watch, nature gives birth to all that moves and does not move. Because of this, son of Kunti, the world keeps turning.
Foolish people look down on me when I take a human body. They do not know my higher nature as the great Lord of beings.
With empty hopes, empty deeds and empty knowledge, their minds confused, they hold to the deluding nature of demons and fiends.
But great souls, son of Pritha, who rest in the divine nature, worship me with a mind that turns to nothing else, knowing me as the unchanging source of beings.
Always singing my praise, striving and firm in their vows, bowing to me with devotion, they worship me, ever steady.
Others, offering the sacrifice of knowledge, worship me as one, as separate, and in many ways, as the one whose face is everywhere.
I am the ritual, I am the sacrifice, I am the offering to the ancestors, I am the healing herb. I am the sacred chant, I am the clarified butter, I am the fire, and I am the act of offering.
I am the father of this world, the mother, the support and the grandfather. I am what is to be known, the purifier, the syllable Om, and also the Rig, Sama and Yajur Vedas.

first: गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत् ।
en: I am the goal, the sustainer, the lord, the witness, the home, the refuge and the friend. I am the origin and the end, the ground, the resting place, and the seed that does not perish.
I give heat. I hold back the rain and send it forth. I am immortality and also death. Arjuna, I am both what is and what is not.

Those who know the three Vedas, who drink the soma and are cleansed of sin, worship me with sacrifices and pray for the way to heaven. They reach the holy world of the king of the gods and enjoy divine pleasures in heaven.
Having enjoyed that wide world of heaven, they return to the world of mortals when their merit runs out. So, following the rites of the three Vedas and wanting pleasures, they keep coming and going.
But to those people who think of me alone and worship me, always steady, I bring what they lack and keep safe what they have.
Son of Kunti, even those who are devoted to other gods and worship them with faith are really worshipping me, though not in the proper way.

first: अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोक्ता च प्रभुरेव च ।
en: For I alone am the one who enjoys and rules over all sacrifices. But they do not know me as I truly am, so they fall.
Those devoted to the gods go to the gods; those devoted to the ancestors go to the ancestors; those who worship spirits go to the spirits; and those who worship me come to me.

first: पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति ।
en: Whoever offers me with devotion a leaf, a flower, a fruit or a little water, I accept that offering of devotion from one whose heart is pure.
Son of Kunti, whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer in sacrifice, whatever you give, and whatever austerity you practise, do it as an offering to me.
In this way you will be freed from the bonds of action, with their good and bad results. With your mind steady in the yoga of renunciation, you will be freed and come to me.

first: समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः ।
en: I am the same to all beings. No one is hateful to me and no one is dear. But those who worship me with devotion are in me, and I am in them.
Even if a person of very bad conduct worships me with undivided devotion, he should be thought of as good, for he has made the right decision.
He soon becomes righteous and reaches lasting peace. Son of Kunti, know for certain that my devotee is never lost.

first: मां हि पार्थ व्यपाश्रित्य येऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः ।
en: Son of Pritha, those who take refuge in me, even if they are of low birth, women, Vaishyas or Shudras, also reach the highest goal.
How much more, then, holy Brahmins and devoted royal sages! Having come into this passing, joyless world, worship me.

first: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु ।
en: Fix your mind on me, be devoted to me, worship me, and bow to me. Keeping yourself steady in this way, with me as your highest goal, you will come to me.
